Take a look at gameplay and get deep dive into The Vow: Vampire's Curse in this trailer for the upcoming dark gothic roguelite that blends tactical, grid-based combat with strategic card-based gameplay, village management and a story of love, death, and resurrection. The Vow: Vampire's Curse will be available on PC. A updated demo is out now on Steam.
In The Vow: Vampire's Curse, take on the role of Sir Richard, a righteous knight whose wedding to his beloved Eleanor is brutally interrupted by the vampire lord Arnaud. When Richard is killed trying to protect her, he is mysteriously brought back to life, changed in ways he does not yet understand. Driven by his determination to reach Arnaud’s castle and rescue Eleanor, Sir Richard sets out on a dangerous journey. Yet the path ahead is far from straightforward, and death is only the beginning.
